Money helpers.

- `currency_round(v, currency)`: rounds to the decimals each currency uses under ISO 4217 (0 for JPY and KRW, 3 for BHD and KWD, 2 for most), without the usual floating-point slip (2.675 USD rounds to 2.68)
- `amount_in_words(v)`: amounts written out as on a check, "One thousand two hundred fifty and 00/100"
- `clamp(v, low, high)`: a value limited to a range

71 functions in all. Every test case passes with the Rhai engine on GitHub and in a Neblex Code step.
